csv_project_name: Task Order Engrg for Bridge Design & Load Rating Support
csv_scope_of_work: CTDOT is seeking to engage one (1) consultant engineering firm to provide structural design and bridge load rating services. The selected firm will be required to perform the following tasks: e Perform and/or update load ratings in accordance with Federal and State requirements Review load ratings performed by others for conformance with Federal and State requirements and sound engineering principles. Perform and/or coordinate material testing, strain gauging, etc. Provide Design Services During Construction. Other tasks as required for the completion of Federal Metrics for load rating and load posting. Provide Task Order engineering services for project administration and bridge and structure design for the CTDOT.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Materials Testing, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
